question: I'm a CS sophomore. I've completed 15-122 (grade: C) and 21-127 (Concepts of Mathematics, grade: B). Am I eligible to take 15-251 (Great Ideas in Theoretical Computer Science)?
expected_answer: Yes — 15-251 requires (15-122 at least C OR 15-150 at least C) AND (21-128 at least C OR 15-151 at least C OR 21-127 at least C). P-002 satisfies both conditions: 15-122 with a C meets the first condition, and 21-127 with a B meets the second condition.
common_mistake: Only checking one of the two required prerequisite conditions; missing that 21-127 satisfies the math component
needs_verification: Confirm P-002's actual grades in 15-122 and 21-127
Confirm 15-251 prerequisite text hasn't changed from: (15-122 C or 15-150 C) AND (21-128 C or 15-151 C or 21-127 C)
Confirm P-002 has not already taken 15-251
